verdict.rationale: Numeral documents its own product-taxability mechanism: products are created and categorized for tax calculation, it offers AI product classification, and it returns a tax amount per address and product set. The evidence never addresses the hard cases the story names or shows the research behind any determination. Missing for 10: state-by-state SaaS taxability handling, digital-goods rules, bundled-offering treatment, visible research or citations behind each determination, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder selling software, the product gets the hard cases right — SaaS taxability that differs by state, digital-goods rules, and bundled offerings — with the research behind each determination visible

citations.quote: Create and categorize a new product for tax calculation purposes.
You'll give us an address and a set of products, and we'll return the accurate tax amount you should charge.
